notes: North is up. Scale ~3.45 px/ft. The canal strip is labelled 'CENTRAL PARKWAY' with '(W. PLUM)' on its west roadway and '(E. PLUM)' on its east roadway (key map: W. Plum / Canal / E. Plum); recorded as two streets, West Plum (centre x~1904, between the block line x~1807 and the canal wall x~2000) and East Plum (centre x~2236, between the canal wall x~2142 and the block line x~2330). The Miami canal (41') is drawn only south of y~2657, with 'Bridge' at its north end by W. 15th and a bridge carrying W. 14th. W. 15th jogs across the parkway: centre y~2606 west of W. Plum, y~2498 east of E. Plum (both recorded as T's), and jogs again at Elm (y~2630 east of Elm). W. 14th centre y~4138 west of the canal, ~4118 east of it. Wade is not drawn across the parkway strip (T at each Plum); Wade west part centre y~778, east part y~827. Streets meeting Central Av. from the west (David St., Armory Av., Clinton St., Betts St.) are adjoining-sheet streets drawn in outline; David and Armory come in on a WNW slant and their T points are their centrelines extended to Central's centre (x~530, block lines x~425 and ~637). Fugate Alley (y~2166, from the west) and Gore Alley (y~2200, from the east) meet Providence about 10 ft apart, recorded separately. N-S 10' alley at x~1450: printed 'ALLEY' between Gore Alley and W. 15th and 'GRANGE' between W. 15th and Orr Alley; recorded as Grange. Thurber: the N-S alley at x~2667-2677 is printed 'THURBER' (12') between Odeon and W. 15th and 'ALLEY' (6', centre ~10 px east) between Wade and Odeon; Dover Alley runs from it east to Elm. Pitt: the 12' N-S alley at x~3228 is printed 'ALLEY' between Odeon and Ohio Alley and 'PITT' between Ohio Alley and W. 15th. Ohio Alley runs Thurber to Pitt only. Wetsel Alley printed 'WETSEL (WEITZEL)'; Adrian Alley printed 'ADRIAN (LERORY)' and 'ADRIAN ALLEY'. '154'' printed in the parkway north of Wade (sheet 83 area). Elm: block lines x~3570 and ~3795, centre ~3681; nothing but Wade's T and W. 14th on its east side except the 15th offset.
